title: Ulyana and the Horizon
author: Noor Oyelaran
blurb: Sable Amberdale, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the jump window closes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
